name: Rot13withdigitshift

description_json.name: Rot13WithDigitShift
description_json.idea: A simple, highly reliable cipher that applies ROT13 to alphabetic characters (preserving case) and shifts digits by 5 (wrapping around 0-9). All other characters, such as spaces and punctuation, remain completely unchanged. This ensures perfect reversibility and high reasoning capability for the model while obscuring the text.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the input string:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions: encrypt(char) = (char_code - 65 + 13) % 26 + 65.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions: encrypt(char) = (char_code - 97 + 13) % 26 + 97.
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it by 5 positions: encrypt(char) = (char_code - 48 + 5) % 10 + 48.
4. If it is any other character (spaces, punctuation, symbols), leave it unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the input string:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(char) = (char_code - 65 - 13 + 26) % 26 + 65.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it back by 13 positions: decrypt(char) = (char_code - 97 - 13 + 26) % 26 + 97.
3. If it is a digit (0-9), shift it back by 5 positions: decrypt(char) = (char_code - 48 - 5 + 10) % 10 + 48.
4. If it is any other character (spaces, punctuation, symbols), leave it unchanged.
